review_question: Among source-defined acute or ischemic stroke cohorts, did the odds of receiving endovascular thrombectomy differ during the COVID-19 pandemic relative to the source-defined pre-pandemic reference period?

pico.population: Source-defined acute or ischemic stroke cohorts

targets.comparison: COVID-19 pandemic period versus the source-defined pre-pandemic reference period
targets.population_or_subgroup: Source-defined acute or ischemic stroke cohort

timepoint_policy.rule: Use each report's explicitly named COVID-19 and pre-pandemic time periods; retain the text of both periods.

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: One source-defined pandemic versus reference cohort contrast per report

targets.quantitative_use_policy: Extract the number receiving EVT and total cohort size for both periods, with a verified table or explicit-results anchor. Do not use target-review forest estimates or infer denominators from percentages.
